item.title: Vaultwarden in Docker: Your Own Password Vault, Not Bitwarden's
item.author: pavel@prohomelab.com (Stilicho2011)
item.description: A step-by-step walkthrough of running your own password vault in Docker instead of trusting Bitwarden’s cloud with it - from a bare-bones compose file to the SSO- and push-notification-enabled setup I actually run.
